notes.title: Cat Powered UFO REMASTERED! Coming very soon! (hopefully end of this month)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UbRgpzW0WK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Cat Powered UFO has a [b]BIG[/b] graphical and gameplay update coming up very soon!  Hopefully by the end of March 2025.

Here is what you can expect!

*  Complete graphical overhaul
*  New level design
*  Alien aesthetics change depending on your items!
*  Leveling up system
*  New battles
*  Bonuses are changed/improved
*  Several quality of life and HUD improvements

Look forward to seeing you play it!  :D
